brief:
A two-month-old boy, Mostafa Hallawin, has remained bedridden at Al-Rantisi Children's Hospital in Gaza City for ten days battling meningitis, according to Middle East Eye. The outbreak is spreading among Gaza's child population as the territory faces acute shortages in medical supplies and personnel.

Healthcare facilities in Gaza are struggling to respond to the epidemic under conditions of severe resource scarcity. The scale of the outbreak and broader impact on other affected children remains unclear as the health system contends with existing crises.
dek: Gaza's children caught in the grip of a meningitis outbreak For 10 days, two-month-old Mostafa Hallawin has been bedridden at Al-Rantisi Children’s Hospital in Gaza City.
title: Meningitis outbreak strikes Gaza's children amid healthcare crisis
